newsitem.title: UK: UK government starts review of water abstraction.
newsitem.headline: UK government starts review of water abstraction.

text.p: The UK government on Tuesday launched a review of abstraction, the system which allows water from rivers to be taken out into supplies, in line with plans announced at a water crisis summit in May.
"A review of abstraction licensing will be starting today," a statement from the Department of the Environment, Transport and the Regions said.
The review will be conducted by the department and the Welsh Office in consultation with the Environment Agency and industry regulator Ofwat.

The department said the review would consider licensing changes which might be needed to ensure full protection for the environment while enabling fair and flexible arrangements to meet properly managed demand.
Interested parties will be invited to submit comments, the department said.
The review will include general principles of the current system, its scope, environmental concerns, time limits, charges and bulk transfers. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
